question_text: In the absence of stress, the center-to-center atomic separation distance of two Fe atoms is 0.2480 nm (along a $\langle 111\rangle$ direction). Under a tensile stress of $1,000 \mathrm{MPa}$ along this direction, the atomic separation distance increases to 0.2489 nm . Calculate the modulus of elasticity along the $\langle 111\rangle$ directions.The unit of the answer is GPa.
response:
The strain along the ⟨111⟩ direction is

$$\varepsilon = \frac{\Delta r}{r_0} = \frac{0.2489 - 0.2480}{0.2480} = \frac{0.0009}{0.2480} \approx 0.003629$$

The modulus of elasticity is

$$E = \frac{\sigma}{\varepsilon} = \frac{1000\ \text{MPa}}{0.003629} \approx 275{,}555\ \text{MPa} \approx 275.6\ \text{GPa}$$

$$\boxed{275.6}$$
